headline: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia Threatens Legal Action Over Rumors
metaDescription: Minister Bahlil Lahadalia has demanded clarification regarding allegations of his involvement in a presidential wiretapping scandal or face lawsuits.
aiSummaryBullets: Minister Bahlil Lahadalia has issued a 72-hour ultimatum for clarification regarding accusations of his involvement in wiretapping activities.
The Minister denied meeting with former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo prior to the latter's arrest in connection with the scandal.
Bahlil claimed he has also been a subject of wiretapping and intends to pursue legal action if accusations against him are not retracted.
aiContextParagraph: A controversy regarding alleged wiretapping of the President of Indonesia has emerged, involving claims that implicate former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo. Amidst the ongoing investigations and public speculation, Minister Bahlil Lahadalia has been targeted by rumors suggesting he participated in meetings with Listyo Sigit Prabowo before the former police official's arrest. Bahlil, who serves as the Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources and the leader of the Golkar Party, has formally denied these allegations. The Minister characterized the claims as unfounded and asserted that he has himself been a victim of unauthorized surveillance. He has mandated that the parties responsible for these accusations provide evidence or public clarification within three days, indicating that he is prepared to file a formal legal somasi and initiate judicial proceedings to address the defamation against him.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction across several national news outlets due to the involvement of high-ranking political figures in an ongoing scandal.
